asterion02.title: The Scribe
asterion02.t01.man: The fingers find the letters on their own. The stone remembers who touches it.
asterion02.t01.beast: stone. old man. smell of ink.
asterion02.mname.hint: The letters of his name. The stone begins to remember.
asterion02.mname.clean: Traced his own name with a steady hand.
asterion02.d01: Many winters before. The bull-boy doesn't have his broken horn yet.
asterion02.d02: A monster? You? You're afraid of rats.
asterion02.d03: Come. Papyrus is dear, and the College counts every sheet. But walls we have plenty. Scratch with me.
asterion02.mteach.hint: Calias scratches; the boy follows the groove.
asterion02.mteach.clean: Learned the letters with a steady hand.
asterion02.mteach.shaky: Learned the letters with a shaking hand.
asterion02.d04a: Steady hand. A little more and you'll read better than the scribes up there.
asterion02.d04b: Crooked. But it's yours. Crooked letters keep things too.
asterion02.d06: A war no one tells of. The names of those who fought in it. Scratch the last one.
asterion02.mheal.hint: Scratch the last name on the list.
asterion02.mheal.healed: Traced a name the stone would not keep.
asterion02.d07: That one the stone won't keep. I've scratched it a hundred times. Tomorrow it's smooth again.
asterion02.t02.man: A name that runs off the stone like water.
asterion02.t03a.man: That festival night, I sang to the crack. On the other side, a small ear pressed against the stone. Then the warmth went away. For the first time.
asterion02.t03b.man: That festival night, I sang to no one. And the warmth went away all the same. For the first time.
asterion02.d08: Scribe! The book. The College knows you copy what it orders scraped away.
asterion02.c01: The book is heavy in the boy's hands. The guards come closer.
asterion02.c01.protect: Run into the dark with the book.
asterion02.c01.obey: Hand the book to the guards.
asterion02.d10a: He runs into the dark with the book pressed to his chest. Behind him, the guards take the old man. No one screams. Calias doesn't scream.
asterion02.d10b2: Calias is spared, for having cooperated. He never speaks to the boy again.
asterion02.d10c: He charges. The guards fall back, shout, come back with more spears. They take Calias. The book is lost in the dust.
asterion02.t04a.man: The book is still in the niche. Sometimes I read the names the College wanted forgotten.
asterion02.t04b.man: Only the letters on the wall are left.
asterion02.d11: High above, at the grate of the upper gallery, a torch. A young guard, alone. He looks into the dark for a long time. Then he takes a piece of bread from his belt, lets it drop through the grate and leaves in a hurry, like someone who has done a forbidden thing.
asterion02.c02: The bread lies on the floor, at the foot of the grate. Still warm.
asterion02.c02.leave: Leave the bread where it fell.
asterion02.t05a.man: Bread. No one up there ever gave anything without a spear behind it. Tomorrow they will see the bread is gone.
asterion02.t05b.man: Fear. A lot of fear. But not of me: of the other guards. And shame.
asterion02.t05c.man: Bread that falls from above is bait. It always was.
